title: Revive ScriptBots into a deterministic Evolution Lab
description: Authoritative implementation epic for PLAN_TO_REARCHITECT_AND_REVIVE_RUST_SCRIPTBOTS.md. Deliver one correct simulation runtime, honest heritable brains, reproducible experiments, FrankenTUI and native GPU frontends, truthful tests, and a serialized dependency modernization program. No file deletion without explicit written permission.

title: Baseline, reproducibility, and honest evidence
description: Capture real red/green baselines; track lock/toolchain/source revisions; repair false tests, CI, and startup contracts before semantic work.

title: Capture and classify the executable baseline
description: Complete the clean-room 2026-07-11 baseline across host-target workspace check, focused tests, clippy, fmt, TUI binary/headless behavior, bounded macOS GUI launch, and live render/golden paths. Classify each red result as code, test, environment, or RCH infrastructure and record exact commands without changing semantics.
design: Evidence-only foundation. Preserve all user changes. Do not fix failures in this bead. Use the host target directory already documented when RCH fails open incorrectly. Plan section Phase 0.1 and Appendix A are authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: The rearchitecture plan records exact commands, exit status, observed failure text, and classification for every required lane; runaway commands are bounded; no failing lane is described as passing; git/toolchain/feature state is captured.

title: Freeze Cargo.lock and mutable Git dependency sources
description: Make source resolution reproducible before semantic work: track the existing Cargo.lock, replace the mutable GPUI branch with the exact currently locked revision, add UPGRADE_LOG, and minimally adjust ignore rules so the lock and required golden assets can be tracked. Dated toolchain proof is a separate bead.
design: Exclusive Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/.gitignore lane. This is a source pin, not a GPUI update. Stop if the lock changes outside query normalization for the 16 currently locked Zed packages. No toolchain/dependency bump or dead-patch cleanup. Plan Phase 0.2 and sections 10.1, 10.10.
acceptance_criteria: Two clean resolutions at the same toolchain select identical package/source revisions; Cargo.lock is tracked; every existing Git source is immutable; UPGRADE_LOG records before/after and rollback; unrelated .gitignore hunks remain byte-for-byte intact; no registry version/checksum changes.

title: Repair CI feature matrix and trackable golden asset policy
description: Audit every CI command/action/feature against the live workspace, repair invalid feature names and stale action references, and define tracked metadata-bearing golden directories without allowing arbitrary runtime frame dumps.
design: Do not update unrelated dependencies here. Preserve semantic CPU references and live renderer captures as different artifact classes. Plan Phase 0.2-0.3 and verification 13.10.
acceptance_criteria: Every CI feature exists; every action is pinned per project policy; cargo metadata validates each matrix lane; expected golden paths are trackable; missing assets fail with generation instructions; CI cannot auto-bless outputs.

title: Make TUI, renderer, and replay tests name the path they exercise
description: Replace ceremonial success conditions: inspect rendered terminal buffers, distinguish CPU surrogate rasters from live framebuffer capture, fail replay verification on empty evidence, and rename any test whose current name overclaims its path.
design: Test honesty first; do not bless current broken output as canonical. Individual renderer migrations remain separate. Plan Phase 0.3 and sections 3.13, 13.5-13.9.
acceptance_criteria: Headless TUI tests assert buffer semantics and current tick; visual tests identify CPU versus shipped renderer; missing goldens are explicit failures; replay verification rejects zero events/digests; each advertised live test executes the named backend.

title: Repair mode selection and startup failure contracts
description: Make explicit modes authoritative, correct macOS GUI availability detection, choose only compiled renderers in Auto, surface window/backend launch failures, centralize startup defaults, and make any bootstrap ticks explicit.
design: Do not redesign the renderer. This bead fixes truth at the application boundary and may expose existing backend failure. Plan Phase 0.4 and section 9.1.
acceptance_criteria: A matrix covers explicit terminal/headless/server/GUI modes, Auto with and without compiled GUI features, macOS launch selection, unavailable backend errors, port defaults, and launch failure propagation; no GUI request silently falls into TUI.

title: Define RunManifestV0 and characterization digest
description: Define a temporary pre-redesign run manifest and digest over the stable state available today: seed, normalized config, scenario identity, toolchain, lock/source revisions, features, and deterministic world fields. Capture representative fixed-seed traces.
design: Characterization oracle, not the final replay schema. Avoid freezing known bugs as desired semantics. Final WorldDigestV1 supersedes it after AgentUid and evaluator-state work. Plan Phase 0.5.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest encoding is versioned and canonical; fixed-seed traces reproduce on repeated runs; digest ordering is documented; artifact identifies itself as V0 and does not claim final brain/RNG/checkpoint coverage; semantic/refactor beads cite the baseline artifact.

title: Build deterministic legacy micro-oracle harness
description: Establish the deterministic legacy micro-oracle format and minimal smoke fixtures, with source citations and parity-versus-policy labels. Each owning core/brain bead adds its focused red fixture so this foundation does not become a giant serial gate.
design: Do not port the whole C++ test environment or pre-implement every future oracle. Provide reusable helpers and proof format; avoid freezing known bugs as desired semantics. Plan section 6.1.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs without GUI/storage; fixture format captures deterministic setup, numeric expectation/tolerance, original-code reference, and policy label; minimal smoke includes at least one sensing and one resource/actuation case; owning semantic beads can add focused fixtures independently.

title: Pin and prove the dated nightly toolchain contract
description: Select an installed dated nightly that preserves Rust 2024 support and the current locked graph, prove it on the documented host-target lanes, align workspace rust-version/CI/docs, and record the rollback. Keep this separate from freezing mutable Git sources.
design: One toolchain mutation lane under library-updater rules. Do not update crates to make an arbitrary nightly pass. Candidate nightly-2026-07-09 is installed but must be proven rather than assumed. Plan Phase 0.2 and 10.1.
acceptance_criteria: rust-toolchain.toml names an exact date; rustc -Vv evidence is recorded; workspace rust-version is truthful; focused check/test/fmt and CI toolchain setup agree; any MSRV conflict is attributed to a specific locked package and stops the bead.

title: Curated scenarios and first-run product
description: Make default launch tell a reproducible ecological story with explicit startup, curated scenarios, onboarding, and post-correctness viability tuning.

title: Define explicit scenario schema and startup construction
description: Define minimal versioned scenario identity/config in RunManifestV0, seed the full world deterministically, remove or expose hidden 120-tick bootstrap, and keep current ecology parameters until honest-brain tuning.
design: Construction only, no ecology tuning. Plan Phase 1.4.
acceptance_criteria: Starting the same scenario/seed produces identical placement and V0 trace; no hidden ticks occur; help/API/TUI identify scenario and bootstrap policy; scenario config validates finite/range constraints.

title: Tune the default meadow as a reproducible living story
description: After the resource ledger, honest brains, domain RNG, and digest exist, tune meadow across seed cohorts so users see sustained foraging, reproduction, variation, pressure, and explainable events.
design: Depends on scientific foundations. This owns cohort tuning split from the core ledger bead. Plan sections 2.2 and Phase 1.10.
acceptance_criteria: Documented cohort meets declared viability/interestingness envelope; failures/extinctions remain visible rather than hidden; no magic bootstrap or seed cherry-pick; default GUI/TUI show the same run; resource ledger balances.

title: Validate curated ecological scenario catalog
description: Implement and cohort-validate meadow, drought/recovery, predator/prey, island/closed-world, cooperation/kinship, and brain-arena stories with explicit hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
design: Split scenario implementations if file/review budget grows. Plan sections 2.3 and 7.7.
acceptance_criteria: Each scenario has versioned config, seed schedule, intended phenomenon, success/failure envelope, screenshots/run bundle, and no undocumented overrides; intervention commands replay at identical ticks.

title: Create truthful first-run onboarding and demo flow
description: Guide a new user from launch through observing, selecting, stepping, changing one parameter, checkpointing, branching, and understanding one evolutionary outcome in both frontends.
design: Product flow after frontends/scenarios work. Plan section 2.2 and Phase 6.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh-install walkthrough succeeds from verified commands; unavailable backends degrade honestly; the user can identify seed/scenario/tick/status; no action is acknowledged before application; docs and in-app hints share command definitions.

title: Experiments and offline scientific analysis
description: Build matched-seed interventions, lineage/phenotype analysis, and optional pinned FrankenSciPy/FrankenNetworkX adapters outside the hot loop.

title: Compute lineage fitness and founder contribution
description: Derive lifetime reproductive success, survival, ancestry, founder contribution, diversity, and lineage turnover from run-scoped event/genome data with reproducible queries and uncertainty summaries.
design: Offline/data-query layer, not simulation hot path. Plan Phase 4.4.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics reconcile against event journal; repeated queries are deterministic; missing/censored data is explicit; one sample run explains a measured evolutionary change; results export with units/provenance.

title: Build phenotype and interaction feature analysis
description: Produce movement, diet, sensing, aggression, giving, reproduction, and interaction-network features; cluster/compare phenotypes with effect sizes and uncertainty.
design: Use DuckDB/native summaries first. Optional sibling adapters follow a separate decision. Plan sections 7.8 and 4.4.
acceptance_criteria: Feature definitions and units are versioned; graphs preserve AgentUid/run scope; clustering/statistics are seed-cohort aware; one report connects phenotype shift to lineage/outcome without causal overclaim.

title: Decide pinned FrankenSciPy and FrankenNetworkX adapters
description: Benchmark exact pinned offline-only adapters for statistical tests/bootstrap/ACF/clustering and lineage/interaction graphs against simpler native/DuckDB paths, including build size, MSRV, licensing, correctness caveats, and API stability.
design: Research integration, no stash/pull required merely to inspect remote. Plan section 7.8 and Appendix B.
acceptance_criteria: Each sibling has accept/reject verdict, exact immutable revision if accepted, narrow optional feature boundary, conformance fixture, and measured build/runtime cost; neither enters tick/default frontend graph; dirty sibling worktrees remain untouched.

title: Run paired checkpoint-branch intervention studies
description: Implement drought/resource, temperature, closed-world, and cooperation interventions from a shared checkpoint with matched branches, verified command ticks, outcome comparisons, and uncertainty.
design: Built on experiment runner and replay. Plan Phase 4.5.
acceptance_criteria: Branches share pre-intervention digest; commands apply at identical ticks; bundles verify; reports include effect sizes/intervals and extinction/recovery/hysteresis measures; divergent outcomes can be traced to first changed command/stage.

title: Web and external-agent interfaces
description: Reuse the canonical runtime/snapshot protocol for WASM, browser rendering, and agent-friendly acknowledged APIs without duplicating scientific time.

title: Expose renderer-neutral WASM snapshot projection
description: Reuse HostCore/snapshot schemas for browser driving and projection without duplicating world semantics or allowing requestAnimationFrame to own scientific time.
design: Wait for stable runtime/snapshot contracts. Plan Phase 5.1.
acceptance_criteria: Native and WASM fixed-seed digest/projection comparison meets declared tier; browser time can pause/step deterministically; schema/version/capability discovery works; browser persistence remains separate.

title: Harden agent-friendly REST and MCP experiment APIs
description: Expose bounded health/status/snapshots, command receipts, scenarios/experiments, checkpoints/artifacts, pagination, and schema/version discovery through the canonical HostClient/data services.
design: Transport reuse, not a second runtime. Plan Phase 5.2.
acceptance_criteria: Conformance covers accepted/applied/durable/rejected, idempotent retry, stale revision, pagination, size limits, disconnect lookup, no-renderer operation, and truthful artifact provenance; APIs cannot mutate WorldState directly.

title: Build and test real browser Canvas or WebGPU frontend
description: Choose a browser renderer after native contracts stabilize, implement actual Canvas/WebGPU presentation, and prove capability/fallback/input/live visual paths.
design: No renderer selection by marketing claim; use measured capability matrix. Plan Phase 5.3.
acceptance_criteria: Real browser screenshots and interaction tests pass; RAF changes only presentation; device/capability fallback is explicit; snapshot backlog stays bounded; exported screenshot/status matches canonical tick/revision.

title: Truthful documentation, packaging, and release
description: Rewrite README/help/docs from verified commands, document architecture/scenarios/troubleshooting, and ship reproducible supported product matrices.

title: Rewrite README and help from verified product behavior
description: Replace stale completion/feature claims with verified install/run/mode/scenario/feature commands, screenshots from shipped paths, limitations, and a concise Evolution Lab walkthrough.
design: Documentation follows evidence gates, not aspirational implementation. Plan Phase 6.
acceptance_criteria: Every command is executed in the supported matrix; screenshots identify actual backend/version; unavailable features are labeled; default first run matches text; old plans are superseded without deleting history.

title: Document runtime, scientific, data, and frontend architecture
description: Create maintainable architecture/contribution guidance for pure core step, HostCore ownership, command revisions/status, snapshot versus journal, brain genome/state, RNG/determinism, storage, and frontend boundaries.
design: Revise existing docs where appropriate; new documentation files only for genuinely distinct durable topics. Plan Phase 6.
acceptance_criteria: Diagrams/types match live code; invariants and forbidden dependencies are testable; extension guides cover brain family/scenario/frontend; de-monolith decisions and dependency holds link to evidence; no stale master-branch reference remains.

title: Publish scenario, experiment, replay, and troubleshooting tutorials
description: Write verified tutorials for first run, matched-seed experiment, checkpoint branch, replay verification, data queries/exports, frontend controls, headless/server use, and actionable doctor/troubleshooting.
design: Generated screenshots/bundles must come from shipped paths and carry metadata. Plan Phase 6.
acceptance_criteria: Tutorial commands produce referenced artifacts on a clean checkout; failure examples use actual messages; users can diagnose renderer/device/storage/RCH/toolchain problems; no secret local paths are required.

title: Verify packaging, release matrix, and main-branch handoff
description: Prove supported feature/platform release builds, installers/packages, sample bundles, licenses, artifact integrity, and clean-checkout startup; prepare a path-scoped main-branch release handoff.
design: No push or release without user authority. Never delete artifacts/files for cleanup without explicit written permission. Plan Phase 6 and Definition of Done.
acceptance_criteria: Release gates, checksums, licenses, SBOM/dependency ledger, feature matrix, run bundle verification, and smoke launches pass; unsupported combinations are explicit; any authorized push to main is immediately mirrored to legacy branch per AGENTS.

title: Scientific kernel correctness
description: Restore sensing, spatial, output, persistence accounting, finite validation, and resource semantics with legacy micro-oracles and deterministic proofs.

title: Fix scalar and SIMD eyesight with chunk-boundary invariance
description: Add red tests proving identical eye geometry/color/density for scalar and simd_wide paths, including at least eight visible neighbors so a full SIMD chunk is mandatory and neighbor counts cross the remainder boundary. Fix the inverted SIMD falloff and scalar heading double-application.
design: Minimal semantic fix only. Do not combine blood FOV, spatial index, brain, or runtime changes. Preserve the public sensor contract unless the legacy oracle demonstrates a documented policy decision. Plan Phase 1.1 and section 6.2.
acceptance_criteria: The pre-fix test fails for the intended reason; default and --no-default-features or no-simd focused lanes agree within the declared tolerance; results are invariant for equivalent neighbor sets at counts 4n-1, 4n, and 4n+1; UBS/fmt/check/clippy pass for changed surfaces.

title: Resolve blood-sensor FOV against explicit policy
description: Use the legacy micro-oracle to prove the current blood-sensor half-FOV mismatch, decide/document parity versus intentional redesign, and make scalar behavior and constants match that policy.
design: Current Rust uses a wider half-FOV than the preserved C++ implementation. Treat this as a policy-bearing correctness change, not a drive-by constant edit. Plan section 6.2.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary-angle tests cover just inside/on/outside the cone; the constant and documentation agree; fixed-seed sensor results are deterministic; no eyesight or combat behavior changes in the same patch.

title: Make toroidal neighbor queries exact and duplicate-free
description: Characterize and repair uniform-grid toroidal queries when radii span repeated wrapped buckets and when Euclidean distance disagrees with toroidal distance. Add boundary, tiny-world, translation, and duplicate-delivery tests.
design: Keep uniform grid as the production baseline. R-tree/k-d-tree implementation claims are separate dependency/feature work. Plan Phase 1.1 and section 6.11.
acceptance_criteria: Every logical neighbor is returned at most once; toroidal shortest distance governs radius inclusion; translating the entire fixture across a wrap preserves results; oversized radii terminate and remain duplicate-free; core sensor digest does not depend on bucket traversal order.

title: Centralize neural outputs and fix boost/combat indexing
description: Replace raw output magic indexes with one typed/range-checked output conversion and fix combat to consume the boost slot rather than the green-color slot. Ensure replay/render/introspection share the same mapping.
design: Do not retune combat in this bead. Preserve intended formulas while repairing field identity. Plan Phase 1.2 and section 6.3.
acceptance_criteria: A green-versus-boost regression proves color cannot change damage and boost can; finite/range handling is explicit; raw numeric output indexes remain only inside the centralized conversion hot path; legacy oracle and existing brain fixtures pass.

title: Decouple lifecycle accounting from persistence cadence
description: Keep current tick summaries honest on every tick and accumulate births, deaths, combat, and other lifecycle deltas until the configured persistence flush rather than clearing them on non-persistence ticks.
design: Pure core accounting change only. Bounded queues, worker errors, durability, and DuckDB schema are runtime/data beads. Plan Phase 1.3.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple events between persistence intervals are neither lost nor duplicated; changing persistence/analytics cadence leaves canonical scientific state and event totals unchanged; last/current summary fields report the actual tick; storage worker lifecycle remains out of scope.

title: Reject non-finite configuration and state inputs
description: Audit floating configuration validation and command patch entry points so NaN and infinities cannot bypass comparison-only guards or poison deterministic simulation state.
design: Validation contract only. Parameter tuning belongs to scenario beads. Plan sections 4.1 and 6.4.
acceptance_criteria: Every public floating config field has a finite/range test; JSON/API/TUI patch paths reject non-finite or unrepresentable values with field-specific errors; valid boundary values retain behavior; no blanket unwrap/serialization workaround is introduced.

title: Make closed-world and population-floor semantics truthful
description: Resolve the mismatch where ClosedWorld disables population injection without updating WorldState.closed, and formalize how closed-world mode, population floors, injection, and scenario transitions interact.
design: Do not tune default population/ecology here. Host command-receipt proof belongs to runtime HostCore/control beads, avoiding a core→runtime dependency cycle. Plan sections 3.9 and 6.4.
acceptance_criteria: Closed/open state is observable and consistent; toggling at tick boundaries has deterministic effects; closed worlds never inject population; configured floors are enforced only under documented policy; current manifest/audit state records transitions.

title: Instrument an explicit food, energy, and health resource ledger
description: Model and report every food, energy, and health source, transfer, and sink without changing scenario tuning. Add reconciliation and invariant tests so later cohort tuning rests on conserved, explainable dynamics.
design: Kernel instrumentation only. Default meadow/scenario cohort tuning is bd-2z0.10.2 and remains hard-gated by honest brains, domain RNG, and WorldDigestV1. Plan section 6.4.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tick and cumulative resource balance reconcile within declared floating tolerance; every mutation site emits an attributable ledger category; unexplained creation/destruction is zero in deterministic fixtures; enabling ledger diagnostics does not change WorldDigest.

title: Heritable brain genomes and evaluator state
description: Introduce stable IDs/random protocol, versioned genome and evaluator-state contracts, real family adapters, inheritance, checkpoints, and honest registration.

title: Introduce stable AgentUid and minimal RandomStream protocol
description: Add stable logical agent identity independent of SlotMap storage handles and define the minimal versioned random-stream interface needed by core and brain families. Adapt the current RNG behind the protocol before choosing a new generator.
design: Protocol foundation for brains/digests. Keep SlotMap for lookup. Do not integrate fnp-random here. Plan Phase 1.5 and sections 6.8-6.9.
acceptance_criteria: AgentUid remains stable across arena churn and serialization; spawn/birth ordinals are deterministic; current RNG state and algorithm identity round-trip; tests distinguish logical identity from AgentId; no scheduler-order domain separation is claimed yet.

title: Decide and implement domain-separated RNG streams
description: Benchmark and integration-spike an exact pinned fnp-random adapter versus the current generator, record accept/reject, then implement versioned streams for environment, food, population, lineage/agent, mutation, and crossover.
design: Do not pull a mutable sibling branch. Any accepted sibling integration uses an exact revision and passes build-size/toolchain gates. Plan Phase 1.9 and section 6.9.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a distant noninteracting agent does not perturb existing agents; arena permutation and analytics cadence do not perturb streams; all stream states checkpoint; generator/source revision is in manifest; rejected fnp path has measured rationale and no lingering dependency.

title: Define versioned brain genome and evaluator-state protocol
description: Separate heritable BrainGenomeEnvelope from future-affecting BrainEvaluatorStateEnvelope, define a family registry and object-safe construction/checkpoint operations, make child state reset/inherit/blend policy explicit, and leave a batch/arena extension point.
design: Protocol-only bead with a strict file budget; concrete family adapters and world integration are separate. No compatibility shims are needed in this pre-user project. Plan Phase 1.6 and section 6.5.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture family round-trips genome and evaluator state; schema/family mismatches fail explicitly; mutation/crossover operate on genomes; evaluator construction is deterministic from genome/state; no Box<dyn evaluator> representation is frozen as the only scale path.

title: Adapt MLP to honest genome and evaluator state
description: Encode all heritable MLP topology/weights/hyperparameters in the genome, encode recurrent/future-affecting evaluator state separately, and implement deterministic construct, evaluate, mutate, crossover, checkpoint, and validation.
design: Implement only the MLP family codec/evaluator. World reproduction integration and demand-driven introspection are separate beads. Plan Phase 1.7 and sections 6.5-6.7.
acceptance_criteria: Codec fixtures round-trip exact topology, weights, hyperparameters, and evaluator state; mutation/crossover change only permitted genome fields; restore produces identical next outputs; legacy damping policy is resolved by an oracle.

title: Adapt DWRAON with legacy parity oracles
description: Implement versioned DWRAON genome/evaluator state and resolve known input-node construction and field-wise crossover differences against the preserved implementation with explicit policy tests.
design: DWRAON adapter only. Do not bundle registry/world changes. Plan Phase 1.7 and section 6.7.
acceptance_criteria: Input-source, recurrent-state, mutation, and field-wise crossover fixtures are deterministic; checkpoint restore produces the same next outputs; every intentional divergence from legacy is documented; offspring genomes remain valid.

title: Adapt Assembly brain program and working state
description: Define which Assembly instructions/program fields are heritable and which registers/memory/working state affect future evaluation, then implement versioned construct, mutate, crossover, checkpoint, validation, and bounded execution.
design: Assembly family only. Keep evaluator-state policy explicit and testable. Plan Phase 1.7 and section 6.5.
acceptance_criteria: Genome and working-state codecs round-trip; invalid opcodes/program shapes fail safely; instruction budget prevents runaway evaluation; restore yields identical next outputs; mutation/crossover preserve structural validity.

title: Bind every offspring to inherited and mutated brain state
description: Replace brain-dropping reproduction with family-aware genome clone/mutate/crossover and explicit evaluator-state initialization. Preserve provenance through queued spawns and arena insertion.
design: World integration after family adapters. Do not tune ecology. Plan Phase 1.7 and section 3.9.
acceptance_criteria: Every child in single-parent and crossover fixtures is bound; family, parent UIDs, genome hashes, mutation/crossover provenance, and child-state policy are correct; a multi-generation fixture proves non-placeholder genomes continue evolving; no clone of a trait object silently drops state.

title: Make scenario brain registration complete and honest
description: Register only brain families that fully implement evaluation, genome heredity, persistence, and checkpoint contracts; add MLP, DWRAON, and Assembly scenario selection; keep placeholder ML backends out of default populations.
design: No model-backend upgrades here. Candle/Tract/Tch/Neuroflow acceptance is separate dependency/family work. Plan sections 3.10 and 6.6.
acceptance_criteria: Default and curated scenarios name an installed honest family; selecting unavailable/placeholder ML returns a clear error; MLP/DWRAON/Assembly each survive spawn and reproduction smoke tests; advertised help/features match registration.

title: Make brain introspection demand-driven and bounded
description: Replace per-agent per-tick eager activation serialization with subscriber/selection-driven bounded introspection snapshots that do not affect evaluation or world determinism.
design: Depends on honest family adapters and snapshot projection design. No UI layout work. Plan sections 5.6 and 6.5.
acceptance_criteria: No activation map or Neuroflow JSON conversion occurs without an active request; request cost and maximum payload are measured; selected-agent telemetry is revisioned; enabling/disabling introspection leaves WorldDigest unchanged.

title: Define WorldDigestV1 and checkpoint envelope skeleton
description: Create canonical stable ordering and versioned digest/checkpoint envelopes covering AgentUid, genome, evaluator state, RNG state, normalized config, terrain/food, spawn ordinals, and future-affecting counters. Add diagnostic per-stage hashes.
design: Schema and in-memory codec skeleton, not durable replay implementation. Requires AgentUid and brain protocol. Plan Phase 1.8 and section 6.10.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated runs produce the same digest; encode/decode is idempotent; changing any future-affecting field changes the digest; stable ordering ignores arena allocation order; stage hashes locate first divergence; V0-to-V1 transition is documented.

title: Sole-owner simulation host and control protocol
description: Extract core side effects; build pure HostCore plus native lifecycle, formal command status/revisions, snapshots, event journal, control migration, and bounded storage.

title: Characterize and specify command semantics
description: Build a truth table for pause/resume/speed/step, config validation/conflicts, overflow, auto-pause, shutdown, and more than 32 queued commands. Specify target one-step behavior and exact tick-boundary application.
design: Characterization/spec bead; avoid runtime replacement. Plan Phase 2.1 and sections 5.3-5.4.
acceptance_criteria: Tests expose the current double-step/stuck-command defects; target policy says step atomically pauses, advances once, and remains paused; overflow/shutdown behaviors are explicit; admitted versus applied versus durable are not conflated.

title: Make storage bounded, fail-closed, and cancel-clean
description: Move blocking DuckDB work behind a bounded lossless journal path, implement pause-before-overflow and fail-closed timeout, surface worker errors, and honor flush/durability obligations through shutdown/recovery.
design: Schema changes are coordinated with data epic. No unbounded channel or print-only failure. Plan Phase 2.8 and section 7.5.
acceptance_criteria: Overload cannot grow memory without bound; unavailable storage pauses before accepted scientific events are lost and fails closed after policy timeout; admitted/applied/durable receipts are distinguishable; failure/recovery/shutdown tests are deterministic and cancel-clean.

title: Run runtime lifecycle, contention, and soak matrix
description: Stress command storms, stalled subscribers, slow storage, pause/resume/step, renderer reconnects, shutdown, and fixed-seed long runs across manual and native drivers.
design: Validation bead after runtime components land; it should not become a place for unrelated fixes. Plan sections 13.4 and 14.
acceptance_criteria: No deadlocks, runaway queues, duplicate steps, lost required events, or scientific digest changes from presentation load; CPU/memory/latency budgets are recorded; failures name the responsible subsystem and reproduce in a focused test.

title: Extract command and storage side effects from core step
description: Make one scientific transition return deterministic StepOutcome/domain deltas, remove command-queue ownership and synchronous WorldPersistence I/O from WorldState, and preserve corrected summary/event accumulation.
design: Semantic boundary extraction after digest and core accounting fixes. This is not a module split. Plan Phase 2.2.
acceptance_criteria: World step has no command transport or storage I/O; a fixed V1 trace is identical before/after the boundary; StepOutcome is sufficient for host publication/journaling; core can run in a pure deterministic test with injected inputs.

title: Spike Asupersync channels, blocking bridge, and cancellation
description: At the isolated runtime ports, run a bounded spike for two-phase MPSC, structured cancellation/obligations, virtual-time tests, and DuckDB spawn_blocking. Compare complexity, build cost, failure semantics, and WASM/native constraints.
design: Selective adoption only. Simulation math remains synchronous HostCore. Plan section 5.7 and Phase 2.3.
acceptance_criteria: A checked-in decision records exact pinned source/version, minimal API prototype, cancellation/overflow results, compile impact, and accept/reject/partial verdict; no Tokio stack is removed merely to satisfy the spike.

title: Define host, client, snapshot, event, and command protocol
description: Define synchronous HostCore ports and separate CommandId, admission sequence, scientific/config/snapshot revisions, event sequence, statuses, deduplication/retry/disconnect lookup, and per-client projection requests. Add a null frontend.
design: Protocol before platform scheduler. Browser must be able to drive the same HostCore manually. Plan Phase 2.3 and section 5.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol tests cover duplicate CommandId, conflict, retry after disconnect, status lookup, rejection/failure, and revision monotonicity; renderers cannot import mutable WorldState; null frontend can drive/observe a run.

title: Implement pure sole-owner HostCore state machine
description: Implement the single world owner with deterministic command drain, pause/speed/step, status transitions, manual injected time, health, and exact tick-boundary application.
design: One state machine, no thread spawning. Depends on pure core step and protocol. Plan Phase 2.4.
acceptance_criteria: Manual-time tests prove exactly-one-step while running/paused, deterministic ordering, deduplication, revision conflict behavior, more than 32 commands, and identical traces across repeated runs; no platform runtime or frontend is required.

title: Drive HostCore with fixed-deadline native lifecycle
description: Add the native scheduler around the same HostCore with fixed deadlines, bounded catch-up, structured shutdown/flush obligations, cancellation, and observable lag/health.
design: Use Asupersync only according to the recorded spike verdict. Browser adapter remains independent. Plan Phase 2.5.
acceptance_criteria: Native and manual-time drivers produce the same command/scientific traces; repaint/window count cannot advance time; shutdown is cancel-clean; catch-up is bounded; pause consumes negligible CPU; no detached simulation thread remains.

title: Publish immutable multi-subscriber snapshots
description: Publish current summary, revisioned static layers, compact dynamic agents, and selected detail through bounded latest-value Arc/watch semantics with independent subscriber cursors.
design: Latest visual state is not the durable event log. Keep scientific events on a separately sequenced journal. Plan Phase 2.6 and sections 5.5-5.6.
acceptance_criteria: Two fast readers and one stalled reader remain bounded and independent; publication does not alter WorldDigest; static layers change only on revision; snapshot memory/copy/latency budgets are measured; no frontend holds the world lock.

title: Add per-client projections and sequenced event journal
description: Implement pure viewport/selection projections keyed per client and a bounded, sequenced scientific-event journal with explicit UI lag/catch-up behavior.
design: No global camera/selection state in host. Durable journal persistence is a data/runtime-storage bead. Plan Phase 2.6.
acceptance_criteria: One client's camera/selection cannot affect another; projections are deterministic pure functions of snapshot/request; event gaps are detectable; slow UI consumers follow documented resync behavior; journal loss policy is never confused with durable storage.

title: Migrate CLI, REST, and MCP control to HostClient
description: Remove direct world locks from control/server surfaces; serve snapshots/status and submit commands with accepted/applied/durable receipts, monotonic revisions, status lookup, and bounded truthful artifacts.
design: Transport adapters only after protocol/snapshot hub. Keep schema/version discovery agent-friendly. Plan Phase 2.7.
acceptance_criteria: Paused and no-renderer server applies commands; CLI/REST/MCP share semantics; config responses never claim application before receipt; audit revision never stalls at 64; pagination/size bounds and ASCII/PNG provenance are explicit.

title: Replay, persistence, and experiment data
description: Implement run-scoped provenance, commands/events/checkpoints/digests, deterministic bundles, multi-run DuckDB, and verification.

title: Design multi-run DuckDB schema and provenance migrations
description: Replace single-run primary-key assumptions with run-scoped tables for manifests, configs, seeds, features/build/source provenance, agents/lineages, metrics, commands, events, checkpoints, and digests. Define safe migration and validation.
design: Coordinate with bounded runtime storage but keep schema logic independently testable. No destructive migration without explicit user permission; create/migrate test databases only. Plan sections 7.1, 7.6.
acceptance_criteria: Two runs with overlapping ticks/agent ordinals coexist; run_id participates in all required keys; manifest provenance is queryable; migration is transactionally tested; schema version and failure recovery are explicit; analytics queries remain bounded.

title: Persist sequenced command status and domain event journals
description: Persist commands, tick-boundary status transitions, nonempty lifecycle/combat/domain events, event sequence, and digest references using the runtime durability protocol.
design: Uses corrected core accounting and runtime storage worker. Do not reconstruct events from aggregate metrics. Plan sections 7.2-7.4.
acceptance_criteria: Admitted/applied/durable/rejected/failed transitions are queryable; event sequences detect gaps/duplicates; births/deaths/combat between persistence intervals survive; an empty domain-event stream cannot satisfy a scenario expected to emit events.

title: Implement full checkpoints and first-divergence replay
description: Persist and restore world, brain genome/evaluator state, RNG streams, commands, config, environment, counters, and manifest; replay from tick zero or checkpoint and report the first stage/tick divergence.
design: Builds on digest/checkpoint envelope, runtime protocol, and journals. Do not call two empty vectors a successful replay. Plan Phase 4.1.
acceptance_criteria: Encode/decode is idempotent; next-tick output after restore matches; tick-zero and checkpoint replay match WorldDigestV1 in the bit-exact lane; empty evidence fails; divergence output identifies tick, stage, expected/actual digest, and relevant artifact.

title: Assemble and verify portable deterministic run bundles
description: Package manifest/source provenance, commands/status, events, checkpoints, digests, DuckDB, exports, and artifact index with integrity hashes and an import/verify command.
design: No silent best-effort verification. Packaging is separate from release distribution. Plan Phase 4.2.
acceptance_criteria: A second clean checkout using the pinned toolchain verifies a bundle; missing/tampered files fail with a precise reason; artifact paths are relative and portable; bundle schema is versioned; verification does not require GUI.

title: Build deterministic matched-seed experiment runner
description: Run scenario variants over matched seed cohorts with bounded concurrency, checkpoint/resume/branch, progress/status, and reproducible summaries using the canonical HostCore and bundle formats.
design: Scientific execution layer, not a UI. Depends on honest brain families, runtime, and bundle verification. Plan Phase 4.3.
acceptance_criteria: An MLP-versus-DWRAON sample produces comparable run bundles with identical environment seed schedule; interrupted batches resume without duplicate runs; concurrency does not change individual digests; resource bounds and failure policy are documented.

title: Provide provenance-rich Arrow, Parquet, and CSV exports
description: Define stable run/agent/lineage/event/metric exports for offline tools, including schema/version/provenance metadata and bounded streaming behavior.
design: Keep offline analytics optional and presentation-independent. Plan sections 7.7-7.8.
acceptance_criteria: Exports round-trip representative data; run identity and units survive; large tables stream without materializing the entire run; schema evolution is explicit; FrankenPandas/SciPy/NetworkX adapters consume exports rather than entering the tick loop.

title: FrankenTUI Evolution Lab
description: Pin/review FrankenTUI and build the responsive World, inspector, science screens, command palette, goldens, input storm, and PTY lifecycle proof.

title: Move legacy Ratatui frontend onto HostClient snapshots
description: Make the current terminal UI consume immutable snapshots and submit HostClient commands, remove direct world locks/stepping, fix current-tick/history reporting, and prove semantic parity before visual replacement.
design: Compatibility bridge, not a permanent shim; it can be removed later only with explicit deletion permission. Plan Phase 3.1.
acceptance_criteria: One step advances exactly once; paused commands apply; report tick equals snapshot tick; renderer cadence cannot advance science; existing controls return receipts; buffer-level shadow tests pass against HostCore.

title: Approve and pin immutable FrankenTUI source and license
description: Compare published crate, exact Git revision, and local source availability for FrankenTUI; review licensing/distribution, API stability, toolchain/default features, and rollback boundary; select one immutable integration.
design: Current sibling HEAD observed at fccff2a7e51d39a927bced882877a45aef5c8d39 but must be reverified at execution. Do not modify or clean the sibling checkout. Plan Phase 3.2.
acceptance_criteria: Decision names exact source/revision/version and license evidence; mutable path/branch is rejected; minimal build spike passes pinned toolchain; default feature impact is measured; implementation beads depend on this decision.

title: Build FrankenTUI Model shell, receipts, and simulator harness
description: Implement the approved FrankenTUI Model/update/view/subscription shell, terminal RAII, HostClient receipt flow, routing, help/status overlays, and ProgramSimulator-based deterministic harness.
design: Shell only; detailed screens/canvas follow. Reuse approved source APIs rather than recreating a pseudo-framework. Plan Phase 3.3.
acceptance_criteria: State transitions and command receipts are deterministic; terminal restoration passes panic/quit paths; minimal goldens cover capabilities and errors; ProgramSimulator can inject time/input/snapshots without a live world.

title: Build responsive layered world canvas and inspector
description: Render revisioned terrain/food/agents/sensors/selection in a zoomable responsive FrankenTUI canvas with compact/standard/wide breakpoints and a selected-agent inspector.
design: Consumes projections only; no world stepping or global camera state. Plan sections 8.2-8.4.
acceptance_criteria: Goldens pass at required terminal sizes and color capabilities; Unicode/emoji widths do not corrupt layout; mouse/keyboard selection, pan, zoom, resize, and density modes work; 1k/10k snapshot render budgets are measured.

title: Implement command palette and acknowledged controls
description: Add searchable command palette and discoverable key bindings for pause/resume/step/speed, scenario/config interventions, checkpoint/export, screen navigation, and diagnostics with admission/application/durability feedback.
design: No direct state mutation. Reuse HostClient command schemas and status lookup. Plan section 8.5.
acceptance_criteria: Every mutating action shows pending/applied/rejected/failed/durable status; palette filtering and keyboard/mouse paths are tested; conflicting/stale config revisions explain recovery; help is generated from the same command registry.

title: Build lineage, brain, experiment, replay, and diagnostics screens
description: Implement Lineages, Brain Arena, Experiments, Replay, Environment, and Diagnostics screens from canonical snapshots/data queries, including checkpoint/export/branch workflows.
design: Split into subordinate implementation slices if any screen exceeds the ten-file review gate. Plan Phase 3.5.
acceptance_criteria: A user can run, inspect, intervene, checkpoint, branch, compare, and export without leaving TUI; slow queries are bounded/cancellable; each screen has empty/loading/error/data goldens; enabling introspection cannot change simulation digest.

title: Prove TUI goldens, input storms, and PTY lifecycle
description: Run deterministic buffer goldens, resize/mouse/key storms, slow snapshot readers, command conflict flows, real PTY startup/teardown, crash/panic restoration, and terminal capability matrix.
design: Tests the shipped FrankenTUI path, not a CPU surrogate. Plan sections 8.6 and 13.5-13.6.
acceptance_criteria: No terminal corruption, leaked alternate screen, stuck input, duplicate tick, or unbounded queue occurs; goldens include metadata and are never auto-blessed in CI; PTY logs identify exact failure; resource budgets pass.

title: Primary native GPU Evolution Lab
description: Characterize current live paths, migrate Bevy to snapshot-only instanced rendering, decide GPUI retention, and prove actual framebuffer visuals/performance.

title: Capture actual current-version Bevy and GPUI live frames
description: Build minimal real current-version Bevy render-app and GPUI window/paint probes, capture actual framebuffer/window evidence with backend/platform metadata, and distinguish API/code red from unavailable hardware.
design: Characterization only; preserve the current rendering implementation. Plan Phase 3.6 and section 9.4.
acceptance_criteria: Each backend has a bounded launch result, real capture or explicit hardware blocker, exact API/compiler fingerprint, and metadata-bearing artifact; CPU surrogate images are not labeled live; no dependency migration starts without this baseline.

title: Make Bevy a presentation-only snapshot consumer
description: Remove Bevy's simulation worker and unbounded snapshot path, consume canonical latest snapshots, send intents through HostClient, and prove window/repaint count cannot change scientific ticks.
design: Current-version adapter before major Bevy migration or visual work. Plan Phase 3.7.
acceptance_criteria: One host drives zero/one/multiple presentation windows with identical WorldDigest; snapshots are bounded; selection/actions return receipts; renderer shutdown/reconnect does not own or duplicate simulation time.

title: Replace per-agent Bevy entities/materials with GPU instancing
description: Batch dynamic agents into instanced GPU buffers/shared materials, update only required data, and add measured culling/LOD only when profiling justifies it.
design: Profile before/after. Do not hide simulation work in Bevy ECS. Plan Phase 3.8.
acceptance_criteria: 1k and 10k agent frame/memory/entity/material budgets pass on documented hardware; visible agent attributes remain correct; buffer updates are bounded; snapshots/digests are unaffected; actual framebuffer captures pass.

title: Render revisioned terrain, hydrology, and food layers
description: Build batched/revision-aware presentation for terrain, water/hydrology, hazards, food density, and scenario annotations using immutable static/dynamic snapshot layers.
design: Presentation only; environment simulation remains core. Plan Phase 3.9.
acceptance_criteria: Static buffers rebuild only on revision; dynamic food updates are bounded; color/accessibility modes remain legible; wrap seams and camera extremes render correctly; golden metadata names backend/device.

title: Implement camera, picking, and acknowledged interaction
description: Add smooth pan/zoom/follow, toroidal picking, selection, overlays, and HostClient actions with per-window projection identity and receipt feedback.
design: No global selection in host. Plan sections 5.6 and 9.3.
acceptance_criteria: Picking works across wrap seams and scale extremes; multiple windows keep independent camera/selection; input cannot advance ticks; rejected/stale actions are visible; camera tests use actual rendered path where possible.

title: Build Evolution Lab HUD and scientific inspector
description: Add scenario/status controls, population/resource plots, timeline/events, selected-agent lineage/genome/brain inspector, experiment/replay status, diagnostics, and accessible themes.
design: Visual polish follows working data/control contracts. Plan section 9.3.
acceptance_criteria: All data comes from snapshot/projection/data APIs; command statuses are truthful; no per-tick eager brain serialization; UI remains responsive at 10k agents; empty/error/degraded states are explicit.

title: Run exact-revision GPUI direct-texture feasibility decision
description: At the frozen GPUI revision, prototype direct texture composition without raw-RGBA per-run quads or blocking live readback, measure build/runtime/visual complexity, and decide dashboard-only, renderer retention, or retirement.
design: A decision/spike, not a silent rewrite. Any retirement needs separate explicit deletion permission. Plan Phase 3.10.
acceptance_criteria: Decision includes live evidence, copy/readback count, frame/latency/memory metrics, API maintenance risk, and comparison to Bevy; no source is deleted; only one primary GUI architecture remains in the roadmap.

title: Prove shipped GUI visuals, lifecycle, and device failures
description: Capture tracked actual-render goldens; exercise launch, camera/input, selection, receipts, screenshot/export, device unavailable/loss/recovery, multiple windows, soak, and supported backend/platform matrix.
design: Final GUI evidence after primary architecture decision and implementation. Plan Phase 3.11 and 13.7.
acceptance_criteria: Every visual claim comes from the shipped path; renderer repaint never changes digest; device failures are actionable; goldens are metadata-bearing and not auto-blessed; frame/memory/CPU budgets and long-run stability pass.

title: Dependency reproducibility and serialized modernization
description: Own the single exclusive Cargo.lock mutation lane: pins, complete ledger, dead dependencies, low-risk updates, and gated major families with updater stop rules.

title: Complete dependency disposition and feature graph ledger
description: Inventory every direct, optional, build, dev, Git, patched, and feature-gated dependency across all workspace manifests and the lock. Record current/latest, usage evidence, source/license/MSRV/platform risk, disposition, owner, and update gate.
design: Read-only research except ledger documentation. Do not mutate Cargo.lock. Use official registry/repository/release notes. Plan section 10.2-10.4.
acceptance_criteria: All direct declarations have keep/update/remove/replace/hold decisions with evidence; mutable Git sources, duplicates, dead declarations, default-feature expansion, and target-specific packages are identified; exact candidate targets and primary-source links are recorded.

title: Modernize ML backend families behind honest adapters
description: Individually assess/update Candle, Tract, Tch, and Neuroflow only where a backend satisfies the full genome/evaluator/checkpoint/reproduction contract and supported-platform build gates.
design: Separate sub-updates by backend. Do not enable all ML features by default or let heavy native stacks block the core product. Plan sections 6.6 and 10.13.
acceptance_criteria: Each retained backend has an exact model fixture, deterministic next-output restore test, mutation/heredity disposition, license/native-runtime notes, feature-isolated build, and expected lock delta; placeholder backends remain excluded.

title: Migrate Bevy and wgpu only through live renderer harnesses
description: Treat Bevy and wgpu as separate major migrations after actual current-version framebuffer harnesses and snapshot ownership are proven. Follow official guides and measure API, shader, device, performance, and asset changes.
design: Bevy and wgpu are separate execution slices even though this umbrella sequences them. GPUI remains a separate task. Plan sections 9 and 10.13.
acceptance_criteria: Each migration starts from green live capture on the old version; real framebuffer goldens and 1k/10k budgets pass after; no renderer can step the world; lock/build deltas are isolated; rollback is documented; hardware-unavailable is not reported as green.

title: Hold exact GPUI revision and run retention migration gate
description: After freezing the current exact revision, use the live harness/direct-texture decision to either intentionally update GPUI to a reviewed immutable revision or hold it with rationale. Never track Zed main.
design: Initial exact pin is in reproducibility bead; this task is the later migration/hold decision. Plan sections 9.5 and 10.12-10.13.
acceptance_criteria: Source revision is exact; current and candidate API/visual/compile evidence is recorded; direct-texture feasibility and renderer-retention decision precede migration; lock delta is isolated; no mutable branch remains.

title: Update WASM, benchmark, and test tooling families
description: Modernize wasm-bindgen/web tooling and dev-only benchmark/property/golden tooling in isolated families after their target lanes exist.
design: Target-specific and dev-only packages remain feature/target isolated. Plan sections 10.7 and 13.10.
acceptance_criteria: Native default graph does not gain browser-only dependencies; wasm check/browser smoke and benchmark/test harnesses pass; CI action/tool versions agree; each lock delta is expected; no test tool silently rewrites goldens.

title: Remove proven dead and redundant dependency declarations
description: Remove only declarations proven unused/redundant by source/feature/build inspection, including the unused num-bigint patch if resolution evidence confirms it, one tightly scoped manifest change at a time.
design: No files are deleted. Stop if a dependency is reachable under an untested target/feature. Plan section 10.11.
acceptance_criteria: Each removal has usage/feature evidence; cargo metadata/check/test/clippy under affected feature matrix pass; expected lock delta contains only the removed package subtree; behavior and public features are unchanged.

title: Update serde, serde_json, and postcard serialization family
description: Modernize the tightly coupled serialization family to researched stable targets, reviewing format/schema implications and exact lock delta before acceptance.
design: Exclusive lock lane and one-family updater protocol. Stop on unrelated resolution drift. Plan sections 10.4-10.6.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip/golden/checkpoint fixtures pass; no unintended serialized format drift occurs or drift is versioned; MSRV/license/security notes are recorded; only the expected family changes in Cargo.lock.

title: Update rand ecosystem behind RandomStream
description: Update rand/rand_distr and related generator crates only after RandomStream isolates their APIs, recording algorithm/sequence compatibility and manifest identity.
design: Do not mix fnp-random decision with a generic upgrade. Exact generator sequences are scientific state. Plan sections 6.9 and 10.
acceptance_criteria: All RNG golden/state/permutation tests pass under the declared compatibility tier; any sequence change creates a new algorithm/version identifier; lock delta is expected; domain-stream and checkpoint work remains reproducible.

title: Update core numeric, parallel, and spatial dependency families
description: Individually modernize rayon, slotmap, wide, and currently used spatial-index crates behind existing behavior tests, with a separate proof/lock delta per package or inseparable family.
design: One package/family per commit/bead note even if tracked by this umbrella. Do not claim R-tree/k-d-tree support unless implemented and tested. Plan sections 10.3-10.6.
acceptance_criteria: Scalar/SIMD and serial/parallel matrices meet determinism policy; AgentId/AgentUid invariants hold; spatial torus oracles pass; performance has no unexplained regression; each sub-update is separately recorded and reversible.

title: Update CLI, tracing, errors, and color families
description: Modernize clap, tracing/tracing-subscriber, thiserror/anyhow, owo-colors/supports-color and small related leaves using one-family lock deltas and snapshot/help checks.
design: Keep stylistic rewrites out of dependency mutations. Plan sections 10 and 15.
acceptance_criteria: CLI help/completions and error codes remain truthful; structured logs preserve required fields; color capability fallback works; no console output regression breaks robot/API modes; each family passes focused and workspace gates.

title: Update Tokio, Axum, Tower, OpenAPI, and MCP stack
description: After host/client isolation, update the server transport family with official migration guides, preserving command receipt semantics, schemas, shutdown, pagination, and error contracts.
design: Do not replace Tokio indiscriminately; Asupersync adoption follows its decision bead. Major updates require transport contract tests first. Plan section 10.13.
acceptance_criteria: REST/OpenAPI/MCP conformance passes; graceful shutdown and cancellation tests pass; no transport owns scientific state; schema diffs are reviewed; expected lock and MSRV/build impact are recorded.

title: Update terminal stack and pin FrankenTUI source
description: After source/license decision and semantic harness, update or replace ratatui/crossterm/tui-textarea with the approved exact FrankenTUI integration and compatible terminal utilities.
design: No mutable local path or branch in product manifests. This is dependency integration, not screen implementation. Plan sections 8.1 and 10.13.
acceptance_criteria: Source is immutable and licensed for distribution; terminal RAII, goldens, PTY, resize, input storm, and accessibility lanes pass; dependency/default-feature delta is recorded; rollback to legacy adapter remains possible until cutover.

title: Update DuckDB and data interchange stack
description: Modernize DuckDB and required Arrow/Parquet/data crates after schema and storage lifecycle tests exist, reviewing native build, platform packaging, file compatibility, and lock size.
design: One tightly coupled storage family at a time. No schema redesign hidden inside dependency adaptation. Plan sections 7 and 10.13.
acceptance_criteria: Migration, query, bounded writer, checkpoint, export, and bundle tests pass; existing supported databases open or fail with a documented version gate; build/package sizes are measured; expected native/link changes are recorded.

title: Isomorphic monolith discovery and confirmed extraction
description: Run the named skill in Standard mode only after confirmation; evidence-score candidates and land only SEAM_CONFIRMED manual extractions with full gates.

title: Obtain de-monolith workspace and mode confirmation
description: Record explicit user confirmation for target /Users/jemanuel/projects/rust_scriptbots, Standard mode, separate /Users/jemanuel/projects/rust_scriptbots__demonolith_workspace, inventory-first behavior, current build routing, confirmed-extraction-only policy, and separate install authority.
design: Required skill pause gate. Do not infer confirmation from the original request or create the workspace early. No file deletion. Plan section 11.1.
acceptance_criteria: The exact confirmation is recorded in the bead; no workspace or helper artifacts exist before it; current repo HEAD/dirty state is captured; no source file has been split.

title: Run ten-plus empirical seam discovery loops
description: In the confirmed separate workspace, run at least ten full phases 2-6 loops over at least two candidate decompositions per monolith, capturing API, behavior, dependency, performance, compile RSS, cycle, and ownership evidence plus explicit verdicts.
design: Follow de-monolith skill exactly. Characterization may use helper artifacts in the separate workspace, while repo source edits remain manual. Plan sections 11.2-11.3.
acceptance_criteria: Every candidate has PROVISIONAL, SEAM_CONFIRMED, or SEAM_REJECTED verdict with evidence; two quiet rounds follow the last viable discovery; zero unresolved candidates remain; inventory scripts do not rewrite project source.

title: Create and execute only SEAM_CONFIRMED extraction beads
description: Translate each SEAM_CONFIRMED candidate into a focused extraction bead and perform manual contiguous moves with root re-exports only where needed, preserving API/behavior/performance and avoiding visibility widening.
design: Dynamic task generator: do not pre-authorize a split. Any surface changed semantically must be freshly rebaselined before extraction. Never delete old files/modules without explicit permission. Plan sections 11.4-11.10.
acceptance_criteria: Each extraction has its own exact baseline and passes API diff, tests/skips/goldens, cycles, clean/incremental compile/RSS, perf, UBS, fmt, check, clippy; semantic edits are absent; rejected/provisional candidates do not move; zero unresolved verdicts remain.
